finalMessage:
I added all five Charred Lemon Orzo ingredients to your shopping list: orzo (250 g), lemons (2), garlic (3 cloves), parmesan (50 g), and basil (1 bunch).

One heads-up: you already had lemons (3) and parmesan (100 g) on the list, so those now appear twice. The app's "Add ingredients" button doesn't merge duplicates and there's no delete control in the UI, so you'll want to skip the extra lemons (2) and parmesan (50 g) lines when you're in the store — the ones already on your list cover the recipe. I didn't place an order since you didn't ask for that.
